title: A new anonymous text model
summary:
A new anonymous text model arrived alongside work to ease authentication contention and tidy up text analytics.

Added `gemma-roblox`, backed by Nebius Gemma 2 9B IT Fast, with tool support and a 1,024-token output configuration.

Disabled per-user metric writes at several request paths to reduce database contention affecting authentication, and added an index for API token lookups.

Moved text-generation success and error analytics out of the text server and added request, cache, generation, and failure events to the cache worker. Cache metadata now retains only selected request headers.

highlights.title: Gemma Roblox joins text
highlights.text: Use `gemma-roblox` for anonymous text requests, with tool support and up to 1,024 output tokens. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemma-roblox).
